question: Virù S.A. avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Sociedad Agrícola Virú S.A.
(known as the
Virú Group
) operates as an independent, vertically integrated international agro-industrial group rather than a subsidiary of a larger multinational parent conglomerate. It is led by its executive management team, including General Manager Yoselyn Malamud, and functions as a primary producer and exporter headquartered in La Libertad, Peru.
